title: I-635 Dallas LBJ East construction photos

pageHeader.title: Construction Photos, LBJ East
pageHeader.subTitle: Project completion ceremony took place on Sept. 14, 2026
pageHeader.lastUpdated: Last updated Sept 15, 2026 (add ribbon cutting photo); created June 23, 2021

text:
The $1.74 billion LBJ East project rebuilt and widened the freeway between IH 30 and US 75, including rebuilding the interchange at Interstate 30.

Pegasus Link constructors, which consists of Fluor and Balfour Beatty, was selected as the design-build contractor in May 2019 with a bid cost of $1.737 billion. The project was originally scheduled for completion in December 2024 but was delayed due to Covid. Main lanes were fully opened in sections, mostly in the second quarter of 2026. The final feature to open was the managed lanes, which opened on September 14, 2026.

A dedication ceremony was held on September 14, 2026 (see last photo).

This and the following photos were taken as the project neared completion in spring 2026. At this time, construction on the north half was virtually complete, with only final striping needing to be done. Most remaining work on the south half was on the interior managed lanes. This driver's view at La Prada Drive shows work in progress on the managed lanes access ramp.

This and the following photos show that work was virtually complete on the north half. As of February 28, 2026, northbound/westbound lanes were striped to the final configuration with five lanes from Jupiter Road northward. This view looks northbound/westbound from the pedestrian crossing south of Skillman/Audelia.
